title: Bounded/memory-only auto-merge from non-shipper branches gets no content privacy scan
observation: hunch-guard's merge-class job auto-merges any same-repo PR whose NET diff (base...HEAD) is inside the bounded class, and ci.yml's memory-only fast path now skips the full gate. No CI step scans committed record CONTENT with src/core/publication.ts scanRecord (the release gate's privacy sentinel is a rehearsal of code behavior, not a content scan), so this gap predates the fast path. tooling/ship-memory.mjs scans every commit's blobs, path names and messages with the full local vocabulary, but only for PRs it pushes itself. A memory-only PR from any other route (feature branch, cloud branch) auto-merges with no content scan, and its intermediate commits (published by the --merge merge commit) are classified only by net diff. Possible fix: run planShip's per-commit check and structural scan (committed vocabulary only, since the local list is not on CI) in the fast path, falling back to the full run on refused-outside and failing on refused-publication; or limit auto-merge to memory/* heads.
evidence: Grep scanRecord|loadVocabulary across repo -> only tooling/ship-memory.mjs, test/publication.test.ts, src/mcp/server.ts, src/core/publication.ts (no CI/tooling gate)
critic review of ship-memory (2026-09-27) finding 6, rated minor, deferred from the fast-path PR as pre-existing
